title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Financial Report Statuses and Financial Report Categories
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 introduces Financial Report Statuses and Financial Report Categories to organize and manage the lifecycle of financial reports, row definitions, and column definitions. Use this when you need to control visibility of work-in-progress and retired financial reporting configurations.
key_points: BC28 adds configurable Financial Report Statuses that manage the lifecycle of financial report, row and column definitions
Categories help organize and find financial reports and are managed from the Financial Report list and card pages
Opening a blocked financial report shows a notification, and selecting a blocked row or column definition shows an inline error
Blocked statuses do not currently change the default financial report settings in General Ledger Setup
This builds on earlier work in which financial reports replaced account schedules

quotes.text: Organize your financial reports with financial report categories, helping you find and manage financial reports.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the new capability to organize and manage financial reports using categories
